svg.title: Plain gradient descent and momentum 0.8 in the valley (w0^2 + 50 w1^2) / 2 from (-4, 1) at lr 0.03: one zigzags and crawls, the other runs along the floor
svg.text: plain descent: 186 steps to a loss below 0.0001
momentum 0.8: 52 steps to a loss below 0.0001
w0 runs left to right, w1 up and down; the walls are 50 times steeper across (w1) than along (w0)
